AC2 satisfied and landed: Gerrit change 2346 ("Refuse gate certification on a stale store") merged as 2598909d25ae12d52b6db62be1660920fc09580e with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

The three gate read paths now assert store freshness and refuse with the distinct verdict `stale-store` rather than certifying against a view other readers do not have: `claim_gate_check` (covering claim, transition open->in_progress, and plan_review_status), `close_plan_review_gate_check`, and `_completion_precheck` (placed before the billable verifier run). Staleness is defined locally with no network -- the durable rebar-push-pending marker, or HEAD behind/diverged from the already-fetched remote-tracking ref. The probe fails OPEN, the gate fails CLOSED. 8/8 mutants killed.

CLOSE ATTEMPTED AND CORRECTLY REFUSED. The completion gate reports four still-unchecked criteria, all of them live-server work that this change does not touch: the deployed store pushing to origin/tickets, backlog reconciliation without event loss, ENV_ID_MISMATCH resolution-or-acceptance, and the LIVE VALIDATION item. No --force was used and the ticket stays in_progress. Those four remain the outstanding work.
